script:
In other recordings, Angela described further experiences that I cannot independently verify. She claimed she had been illegally adopted into a CIA mind-control program (`AQ-0011`), tortured as a child at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, and that she had personally helped law enforcement track down a kidnapped thirteen-year-old girl in New York using only a first name and an Xbox account (`AQ-0195`).

Later on, some of her former friends would allege on the record that she fabricated key parts of her personal history (`AQ-0206`, `AQ-0209`). Angela insisted every word was real and dared critics to prove her wrong (`AQ-0056`).

When I first got to know her, I was not investigating her childhood. Someone says they survived something awful and want to protect children, and your instinct in a late-night conversation is to listen. And when Angela talked about why she kept meticulous notes on everyone and everything in her life, she gave an explanation that made you feel sympathy for her: she said her father had taught her as a little girl to keep a hidden journal so she could survive her abusers and beat them in court.

I gave Angela a microphone in my rooms whenever she wanted one. I spent hours talking with her offline, helped her look for family records, and started building a website for her so she'd have a place to lay out her research.

In those rooms, other hosts heard things they valued in Angela. Here is Mellow Demon describing how he saw her during one long conversation.

Later in that same room, Angela talked about forgiveness, making mistakes, and holding yourself accountable.

At the time, those did not sound like empty words to me.

In February 2026, Angela went out of her way on live broadcasts to praise my Spaces as open, respectful, and free of drama:

In a different February-tagged room, two women were angry that Angela would not label Mellow Demon a pedophile over an AI-generated image involving baby Jesus. Angela described the danger of labeling innocent people without enough evidence. The dispute was not about me.
